title: A Volunteer Programme
instructions: Listen carefully. Choose the option that best matches what is said or implied.

audio.description: A Volunteer Programme. Locally generated synthetic English speech.

transcript.text: The animal shelter needs volunteers for weekend mornings, particularly people who can commit for at least three months. New volunteers do not handle animals immediately; they first attend a safety session and help with cleaning and food preparation. Experience is welcome, but reliability is more important.

options: Visitors who can stay one day
Three months of unpaid office work
